notes.title: 🎵 Mercyful Flames: The Witches OST out now 🎵 - the dungeon synth soundtrack will support an organisation dedicated to reducing animal suffering 🐣
notes.content:

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/40401317/3d41254d2429561820559ff8f71ce5476c152af8.jpg[/img]

The majority of [b]proceeds [/b]from the pre-sale of the CD version of the OST and t-shirts go directly to [b]Anima International,[/b] an organisation [b]dedicated to reducing animal suffering[/b].

Listen to the full OST here: 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BMRgP67oHII 
Spotify - https://open.spotify.com/album/5uYLlYDCkCxzuNfK6AEpn2

Wishlist and Follow:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1066740/

In other news
- we just passed [b]3,000[/b] followers on Steam! Thank you!
- we continue our [b]charity efforts[/b] with Dagon
- ...and we're working on some cool stuff for [b]Pool of Madness [/b]([b]32,000[/b] wishlists and counting)

That's all for now, thanks for reading!

notes.title: Steam Co-op Fest, new demo, future plans for our Lovecraftian roguelite pool🎱🐙
notes.content:
Occultists! We've just released a [b]limited playtest [/b]of our roguelite combining pool and cosmic horror.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44962023/924b5ca139c5ed65912e8695e7961b0a11bfb9e9.gif[/img]

It features single-player and coop modes, made especially for [b]Steam Couch Co-op Fest[/b]!


[h1]TRY IT OUT, GET THE DEMO HERE:[/h1]

store.steampowered.com/app/2873750/pool_of_madness/ 


[h1]WHAT IS THIS ABOMINATION?[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44962023/26037a494575f388a96043a6412d9ea4083cb5e0.gif[/img]

Think Inscryption meets Diablo/PoE meets a twisted game of pool. [b]A unique experience with lots of mystery, emergent gameplay and endless replayability[/b]. That's the goal for the full version of the game.

While this is the first stab at a PoM multiplayer mode and we expect A LOT to change, we feel it's already fun and [b]we could really use your feedback[/b] as we continue building Pool of Madness into our dream game.

This is definitely one of our favourite projects we've worked on and the most unique one, so it's great to see players already appreciating the core features!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44962023/a1131695a7d969e2ef1cf980ff7007961275b329.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44962023/4203c595a622626b1b201c3a4069a7ee58781e5c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44962023/2644810ec3c401f190d9943647c2f9ff1e91b826.png[/img]

PS It works great on Steam Deck!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44962023/de65a69505abc5a9abe219e2e4f39d9f7f920e24.jpg[/img]

[h1]CHANGELOG[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44962023/a05115bb71d175ef512c1e26ba250ba5dca41963.gif[/img]

Changes from the previous limited playtest include:
- a hotseat coop mode featuring a new totem
- new powerups
- completely new UI (still WIP, similarly to other features)
- premium pockets (that will feature increasing modifiers later down the line)
- many bugfixes

[h1]WHAT'S NEXT?[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44962023/460503ec1a62b5a2f13c0b2c57e7c53f3f8c3539.gif[/img]

We're currently focusing on [b]making the gameplay as much fun as possible[/b], testing out different ideas and features, as well as working on the story in parallel. This is why these imperfect playtests are so important, as they allow us to [b]gather feedback from players [/b]around the world while the game is still in development.

Things will be rough for a while in terms of the overall presentation, until we're satisfied with the gameplay part and implement & test various features, then we'll begin focusing more on the audiovisual side of things.

[b]Thank you[/b] for taking the time to check out [strike]this crazy abomination[/strike] our eldritch baby of a game! We think we have something really special here - we'd love you to help us shape it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44962023/fa0e431f5cd37ee84389f571a716862e1f523381.gif[/img]

Want more forbidden knowledge? Check the Steam description!

notes.title: New limited-time demo of Pool of Madness out NOW with new graphics and physics!
notes.content:
Fellow friends, scholars and abominations!

After the previous early demo we disappeared into the depths in order to emerge yet again, with a new [b]limited time[/b] version of Pool of Madness for your eldritch pleasure! Give it a spin and let us know what you think!

The demo is now LIVE on our Steam page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2873750/

Pool of Madness Endless Replayability Fest Demo - [b]major updates[/b]:
[list]
[*] updated graphics, visibility & high resolution
[*] rewritten physics
[*] new feature: ability to freeze the ball (check Help), making the gameplay more dynamic and unique
[*] new phase, power bar, explosion & blood marks and other smaller changes!
[/list]
The first super early demo was a huge success, resulting in [b]11,000 wishlists [/b]and a very enthusiastic response from players, which was an awesome surprise! We've used your feedback to introduce some updates to the game and plan to do the same with the current demo, so [b]we'll really appreciate all your opinions[/b] (here on our Steam forum, Twitter or Discord!).

Please note that Pool of Madness is very much a work in progress and we're working on improving every aspect of the game. We're sharing an updated demo so we can continue gathering feedback from players early and shape the game together. 

So... grab the demo and let us know what you think!
